reuse.why: The new action reuses getBulkBudgetCategories, averageToBudget, spreadsheet access, batching, and the existing mutation and undo wrappers.

duplication.why: Category eligibility and amount sign conversion remain shared rather than being copied into individual actions.

placement.why: Selection and budget calculations stay in budget/actions.ts, while handler registration stays in budget/app.ts.

scope.why: The diff is limited to the requested bulk-action rules, new action, handler registration, and related tests.

maintainability.why: All month-wide consumers use one eligibility definition, with explicit options for hidden categories and the existing missing-group variation.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All changed month-wide actions, including setLastMonthSpending, call getBulkBudgetCategories and reuse existing budget-writing helpers.

disguised_duplication.where: The diff extends shared selection logic and reuses shared sign conversion without introducing reshaped copies.

abstraction_drift.where: getBulkBudgetCategories replaces includeHidden with includeHiddenCategories, retains skipMissingGroup, and incorporates the requested exclusions without consumer-specific branches or bypasses.
